correctness.rationale: PASS: Weighted Cayley adjacency is diagonal in Walsh characters with eigenvalue -sum_i J_i+2sum_{i in T}J_i+(-1)^|T|t, t=(-1)^d K. Strict positivity J_i>0 confines the minimum to T=empty or singleton weakest direction, with transition t=J*. Every such character is binary and attains the Rayleigh bound. Any other binary minimum becomes affine Boolean g=a0+sum_{i in I*}a_ix_i upon multiplying full-parity character; g^2=1 forces pairwise products of its coefficients zero and one coefficient ±1. This rigorously exhausts states including degeneracy. Independent full spin brute-force d=2..4 for six anisotropic/signed cases reproduced energies and exact minimizer sets.
